knowledge.name: Unit 1 What is your family like? / Story
Story reading: a family photo
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What is your family like? / Story
knowledge.explanation: 读 Family photo 故事图，能用 This is my family. / This is my dad. 介绍家人，认读 family、dad、mum、sister、brother。

knowledge.name: He is and She is 指认家人
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What is your family like? / Story
knowledge.explanation: 指认家人时按性别选 He is / She is；this 是单数，配 is。常错点：用 She 指爸爸、用 They is。

knowledge.name: I love my family 表达情感
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What is your family like? / Story
knowledge.explanation: 用 I love my family. 表达对家人的爱；主语 I 后用动词原形 love，不加 s。
prerequisites: He is and She is 指认家人

knowledge.name: Story order: first and last
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What is your family like? / Story
knowledge.explanation: 故事顺序词 first / then / last / next，用来交代先见到谁、最后见到谁。

chapters.name: Unit 1 What is your family like?

questions.stem: Look at the story picture. Mum says: "This is my family." What is she doing?
questions.analysis: This is my family. 是把家人介绍给别人看，选 A；B 询问名字要用 Who is he?，C 道别用 Goodbye，D 说年龄用 I am seven.
questions.knowledge_point: Story reading: a family photo

questions.stem: Which sentence introduces one person near you?
questions.analysis: 单数人物用 This is + 人，选 A；B 中 This 不能配 are，C 中 These 是复数且不能配 is，D 语序错误，is 要放在 This 后面。
questions.knowledge_point: Story reading: a family photo

questions.stem: The sentence "This is my family." is used to introduce your family.
questions.analysis: This is my family. 就是把一家人介绍给对方，说法正确。
questions.knowledge_point: Story reading: a family photo

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: This ____ my family.
questions.analysis: 主语 This 是单数，be 动词用 is，故填 is；写成 are 就与单数主语不搭配。
questions.knowledge_point: Story reading: a family photo

questions.stem: Which sentences can introduce a family member?
questions.analysis: A This is my father. 介绍爸爸 ✓；B Sit down, please. 是课堂指令，不是介绍 ✗；C This is my mother. 介绍妈妈 ✓；D I am fine. 是回答近况 ✗。故 A、C 成立，B、D 不成立。
questions.knowledge_point: Story reading: a family photo

questions.stem: In the photo, Dad is on the left. Who is he?
questions.analysis: 指男性家人用 He is，选 A；B 用 She 指女性，C 用 It 指物，D 中 They 是复数且不能配 is。
questions.knowledge_point: He is and She is 指认家人

questions.stem: Tom points to a boy and says: "____ is my brother."
questions.analysis: brother 是男孩，用 He 指代，选 A；She 指女性，It 指物，They 指复数。
questions.knowledge_point: He is and She is 指认家人

questions.stem: "Who is she?" "____ my sister."
questions.analysis: 问句用 she，答句也用 She is，选 A；B 用 He 与 she 不一致，C 用 It 指物，D 中 They 是复数不能配 is。
questions.knowledge_point: He is and She is 指认家人

questions.stem: "He is my grandpa." tells us the person is a man.
questions.analysis: grandpa 是爷爷，男性，用 He 指代正确，说法正确。
questions.knowledge_point: He is and She is 指认家人

questions.stem: This is my sister. ____ is six years old.
questions.analysis: sister 是女孩，句首用 She 指代，故填 She；填 He 指代男孩，与 sister 不符，句首还要大写首字母。
questions.knowledge_point: He is and She is 指认家人

questions.stem: Which sentences are correct about family members?
questions.analysis: A dad 是男性，用 He 正确 ✓；B dad 是男性却用 She，指代错误 ✗；C mum 是女性，用 She 正确 ✓；D mum 是女性却用 He，指代错误 ✗。故 A、C 成立，B、D 不成立。
questions.knowledge_point: He is and She is 指认家人

questions.stem: Your cousin comes to your home in Shenzhen. Write two sentences to introduce your cousin to your parents.

answer.value: This is my cousin. She is nine years old.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：①用 This is + 人 介绍表哥/表姐（1 分）；②用 He is / She is 说明年龄或身份（1 分）；③两句英文完整、主谓一致（1 分）；④拼写与标点正确（1 分）。只写名字不得分。
questions.knowledge_point: He is and She is 指认家人

questions.stem: I ____ my family very much.
questions.analysis: 主语 I 后用动词原形 love，选 A；loves 用于第三人称单数，loving 是现在分词，to love 不能单独作谓语。
questions.knowledge_point: I love my family 表达情感

questions.stem: "I love my mum and dad." shows your feeling for your family.
questions.analysis: love 表示喜爱，这句话表达了孩子对父母的爱，说法正确。
questions.knowledge_point: I love my family 表达情感

questions.stem: I love my ____. She cooks nice food for me.
questions.analysis: 从 She cooks 可知是一位女性家人，故填 mum；填 dad 与 she 不一致，填 sister 意思也通但与「做饭照顾我」的通常语境不符时以 mum / mother 为准。
questions.knowledge_point: I love my family 表达情感

questions.stem: Which sentences are about loving your family?
questions.analysis: A 主语 I 配 love，句意完整 ✓；B I 后误加 s，主谓不一致 ✗；C 主语 We 配 love，句意完整 ✓；D 句末多了 's，所有格使用错误 ✗。故 A、C 成立，B、D 不成立。
questions.knowledge_point: I love my family 表达情感

questions.stem: Which sentence is a good ending for a family story?
questions.analysis: 故事结尾回到「爱家人」这一主题最合适，选 A；B 是课堂指令，C 是跟老师道别，D 只说了年龄。
questions.knowledge_point: I love my family 表达情感

questions.stem: Write two sentences about your family: introduce one person, then say you love your family.

answer.value: This is my dad. I love my family.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：①用 This is 介绍一位家人（1 分）；②写出 I love my family 之类的表达（1 分）；③两句完整、主谓一致（1 分）；④拼写与标点正确（1 分）。只有一句或缺少介绍对象扣分。
questions.knowledge_point: I love my family 表达情感

questions.stem: In the story we meet Dad first and Mum next. Who comes first?
questions.analysis: first 表示最先出现，故事里先出现的是爸爸，选 A；Mum 是 next 之后出现的。
questions.knowledge_point: Story order: first and last

questions.stem: "First ... Then ..." tells the order of a story.
questions.analysis: First 与 Then 都是顺序词，用来交代先后，说法正确。
questions.knowledge_point: Story order: first and last

questions.stem: ____, I meet my dad. Then I meet my mum.
questions.analysis: 与后面的 Then 对应，前面用 First，故填 First；句首需大写首字母，写 first 也算意思对但不符合句首书写规范。
questions.knowledge_point: Story order: first and last

questions.stem: In the story, the LAST person we meet is my grandma. Which word tells us this?
questions.analysis: last 表示最后，与「最后一个见到的人」对应，选 A；first 是最先，then / next 是接着。
questions.knowledge_point: Story order: first and last
